#!/bin/bash
declare -A PID_MAP
PID_MAP["/root/autodl-tmp/rl-active-probe-fl/data/trajectories_v9_icl_cuda0"]=884782
PID_MAP["/root/autodl-tmp/rl-active-probe-fl/data/trajectories_v9_icl_cuda1"]=885180
PID_MAP["/root/autodl-tmp/rl-active-probe-fl/data/trajectories_v9_icl_cuda4"]=885698

CAP=300
LOG="/root/autodl-tmp/rl-active-probe-fl/logs/cap_v9.log"

while true; do
  all_done=true
  for dir in "${!PID_MAP[@]}"; do
    pid=${PID_MAP[$dir]}
    f=$(ls "$dir"/train*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -z "$f" ]; then
      all_done=false
      continue
    fi
    lines=$(wc -l < "$f")
    echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') $dir: $lines lines, PID $pid" >> "$LOG"

    if [ "$lines" -ge "$CAP" ]; then
      if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') KILLING PID $pid ($dir reached $lines >= $CAP)" >> "$LOG"
        kill "$pid"
        echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') PID $pid killed" >> "$LOG"
      fi
    else
      if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        all_done=false
      fi
    fi
  done

  if $all_done; then
    echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') All processes done or killed. Exiting monitor." >> "$LOG"
    break
  fi

  sleep 60
done
